criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 3 June 2028 (12 months after the 3 June 2027 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.

Identifies that the Penrith Systems Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($1,000,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 3 June 2028 (12 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 3 June 2030 (36 months after Closing).
Lists the Penrith Systems Ltd change-of-control consent as a required third-party consent and states it has not been obtained.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (12 months) and as a date (3 June 2028), with days remaining from 10 May 2027 (390 days).
Gives a concrete recommended action for each issue (what to request, amend or negotiate).
